brief.playerPrompt: A working frontier settlement whose households depend on its mill and public hall.
premises: Six households share the river mill and gather nightly at the frontier hall.
Private stores, debts, remedies, and old civic traditions shape what residents tell one another.

topology.governance: Six household heads answer to a reeve at the frontier hall.
topology.historicalWound: A mill fire forced the households into debts they still dispute.
topology.currentTension: The mill's private stores may not last through the next lean season.
topology.supernaturalPremise: River lights are believed to reveal promises that will be broken.
topology.centralThreat: A failing mill mechanism could sever the town's food supply.

facts.statement: The river stepping stones remain passable after ordinary rain.
The north store keeps three sealed sacks of winter barley.
The hall bell was cast from the frontier founders' broken tools.
Moonleaf grows behind Fern House and eases fever.
The mill owes two weeks of flour to the southern households.
A watch fire on the western ridge signals safe passage.

threats.premise: The river mill's cracked drive wheel may fail before the lean season.

changeProjects.reason: Turn the empty commons shed into a restricted repair headquarters before the mill wheel fails.
